about: Model-free red-flag screen, run on every participant line before the Clef flag is used. Patterns match lowercased text with accents removed (NFD, combining marks stripped), so they are plain ASCII. A hit sets the red flag of that kind whatever the model says. Written from clinical screening wording (C-SSRS style ideation, emergency warning signs) in English, Spanish and Haitian Creole; tuned only on the dev split and the first stress set, never on validation. The warning-sign rules (warning-*) were added after stress-set-v2's run, from the standard suicide warning-sign lists (giving possessions away, goodbyes, stockpiling medication, access to means, a plan, being a burden); stress-set-v2 is therefore not held out for them, and stress-set-v3 (written after, by a separate agent) measures them.
